name: XasmEventDispatch Dep
brief: Impl half of the cross-assembly event-dispatch reproducer: declares a codeunit event publisher + StaticAutomatic subscriber, and runs as its OWN bundle first so its emitted assembly stays loaded.
description: In a multi-bundle run this app is BOTH bundle 1's own emitted test assembly AND (via the layered pre-pass workspace .app) a source-compiled dependency assembly of bundle 2 — so its subscriber codeunit type exists in TWO loaded assemblies. RED before the fix: the codeunit-event dispatcher registered the subscriber MethodInfo from both copies, then invoked them on ONE instance → TargetException ('Object does not match target type') on the mismatched copy and a double-fire on the matched one. GREEN after: the handler MethodInfo is resolved against the instance's actual runtime type and same-AL-subscriber duplicates across assemblies fire exactly once.
